subtasks.title: Design and Implement Docker Container Option
subtasks.description: Create an optional Docker-based isolation layer for enhanced security when running untrusted code
subtasks.details: Create Dockerfile for sandbox environment with Node.js, npm, and Vite pre-installed. Implement Docker container lifecycle management (create, start, stop, remove). Build volume mounting system for code synchronization between host and container. Implement network isolation with controlled port exposure. Create resource limits (CPU, memory) for containers. Build container health checking and auto-restart mechanisms. Implement fallback to local execution when Docker is not available. Add configuration options for Docker vs local execution preference.

subtasks.title: Create Process Cleanup and Resource Management System
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive cleanup mechanisms to properly terminate all spawned processes and free resources on application shutdown
subtasks.details: Implement process tracking registry to maintain list of all spawned child processes. Create graceful shutdown handlers for SIGINT, SIGTERM, and process.exit events. Build cascading termination that kills child processes before parent. Implement zombie process detection and cleanup. Add timeout-based force kill for unresponsive processes. Create resource leak detection for file handles and network connections. Implement cleanup verification to ensure all resources are freed. Add logging for cleanup operations and any failures.

subtasks.title: Implement Code Validation and Sanitization
subtasks.description: Build a validation system to analyze and sanitize generated code to prevent malicious execution and security vulnerabilities
subtasks.details: Implement static code analysis using AST parsing to detect dangerous patterns. Create blocklist for dangerous Node.js modules (fs, child_process, net without restrictions). Build import/require validation to prevent loading of unauthorized modules. Implement Content Security Policy (CSP) generation for frontend code. Create SQL injection and XSS detection for generated code. Add rate limiting for resource-intensive operations. Implement sandbox escape attempt detection in generated code. Build configurable security levels (strict, moderate, permissive) for different use cases.
